name: common-skills
description: BEYONDEE shared agent skills for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Submit PRs and promote branches across multiple repositories.
interface.longDescription: BEYONDEE Skills bundles shared agent skills for Codex and Claude Code. It currently exposes multi-repo, which handles a folder of independent Git repositories: submit commits task work, merges the latest source branch (resolving conflicts), pushes and creates or updates the PR; sync merges the latest source into the task branch locally and deletes merged remote task branches; status reports branch, source and PR state; and promote advances remote branches through dev, dev2 and prod with fast-forward pushes only.
defaultPrompt: Use $common-skills:multi-repo status to inspect every repository in this folder.
Use $common-skills:multi-repo sync to bring every repository's task branch up to the latest source.
Use $common-skills:multi-repo submit to commit, merge the latest source, push and open PRs for every repository.
Use $common-skills:multi-repo promote to advance the source branches through dev, dev2, and prod.
